title: Architecture Doc And Multi Project Contract
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Create repo-tracked architecture, registry, tool-contract, response-envelope, security-model, build-series, and decision docs for the multi-project read-only evidence facade.
why_this_packet_exists_now: Implementation should not start until the multi-project trust boundary, registry contract, response envelope, denylist, and packet series are committed. Design docs are the guardrails; without them Codex will freestyle with a flamethrower.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Convert the GPT-5.5 architecture decisions into repo-tracked docs.
Add TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_LOAD.md summarizing the TO load sequence.
Add DECISIONS.md with explicit DCP decisions and rejected alternatives.
Add task packet markdown files for TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0002 through TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0008.
Update README.md and task-packets/INDEX.md if those files exist and pathing is confirmed.
out: No changes to ConPort, dope-memory, dope-context, task-orchestrator, dopecon-bridge, dopetask, or repo-truth-extractor runtime files.

invariants: Facade is documented as non-authoritative evidence projection only.
Every tool contract requires project_id except list_projects.
Project registry is explicit approval; dopemux init is eligibility, not exposure.
plan: Inspect existing discovery pack and confirm files are present.
Create ARCHITECTURE.md using the 20-section DCP architecture structure.
Create MULTI_PROJECT_REGISTRY_CONTRACT.md with registry schema, validation rules, project eligibility vs exposure decision, resolver flow, symlink rules, and capability model.
Create TOOL_CONTRACT.md with Phase-1 and deferred tools, schemas, allowed routes, denied routes, and authority labels.
Create RESPONSE_ENVELOPE_SCHEMA.md with canonical envelope and status semantics.
Create SECURITY_MODEL.md with tunnel, prompt-injection, redaction, stale-proof, and side-effect controls.
Create DECISIONS.md with accepted decisions and rejected alternatives.
Create packet markdown files for TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0002 through 0008 in task-packets/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly/.
Update README.md and task-packets/INDEX.md only if present and update location is unambiguous.
Run markdown/link/path validation and inspect diff.
exact_commands: rg -n "dopecon-bridge|search_all|project_id|readonly|read-only|registry|response envelope|Secure MCP Tunnel" docs/03-reference/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly task-packets/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly || true
validation_gates: Docs include multi-project registry and resolver contract.
proof_requirements: PROOF.json with branch, head_sha, docs created, validation commands, exit codes.
AUDIT.md challenging authority labels, bridge denial, search_all denial, project registry assumptions, and scope boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture docs are committed or commit-ready.
TO load doc and task packets exist.
All unresolved facts are labeled UNKNOWN rather than invented.
rollback_steps: Delete docs created under docs/03-reference/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly that were created by this packet.
Delete task-packets/dcp/chatgpt-mcp-readonly files created by this packet.
stop_conditions: Updating INDEX would require resolving unrelated historical drift.
A design doc requires a runtime fact not present in TP-DCP-MCP-RO-0001.
Any secret pattern appears in generated docs.
Any runtime/service/config file would need editing.

auditor_focus: Does the architecture accidentally make facade an authority?
Does any doc allow dopecon-bridge in Phase 1?
Does any doc allow generic search/fetch before source-label integrity is implemented?
Does registry design auto-expose initialized workspaces?
